description:
We are ORBIT4, a team of four passionate students interested in AI, full-stack development, and space technology. We aim to use NASA's open data to build innovative software solutions for real-world challenges. Our strengths include AI/ML, web development, research, creativity, and teamwork. We welcome collaborators passionate about space, coding, and innovation. Together, we aim to turn bold ideas into impactful solutions.

ORBIT4 — United by Innovation!
